about: Read-only addresses of NFL Challenge v2.01 game variables used by the Modern view (godot/ui/game_state.gd). Facts about the binary, no game data. Offsets are in DGROUP (link segment 23D6, run-time segment 24F8 at the fixed load segment 0122, linear base 0x24F80). Types: u8, s16 (little endian; several words are at odd offsets). Evidence: 'code' = read from the disassembly (tools/disasm), 'diff' = found by memory diffing in the oracle/recompiled runs (tools/modern/research.py), 'check' = verified by tools/modern/check_positions.py. See docs/MODERN_UI.md.

quarter.evidence: code: save game writes [57EA] under 'Quarter and time' (ovl 3 203D:0413)

poss.meaning: team with the ball: 1 home, 2 visitor
poss.evidence: code: 0031:0D34 sets [57EC] and the defence [57EE]; save game 'tm w/ball' (203D:052B)

clock_min.evidence: code: 0AAB:0596 returns [6719],[6717] as min, sec; diff: equals the scoreboard clock in 11,054 text frames

play_clock.evidence: diff: equals the scoreboard value in every text frame of the boot run

spot.meaning: ball spot in yards from the left goal line of the text field (0..100). Updated to the play's result before the play is shown
spot.evidence: code: 0BFF:0134 getter, 0BFF:0166 flips 100-x; diff against the field marker

series_start.meaning: spot where the current set of downs started; first-down line = series_start + 10 * dir
series_start.evidence: code: 0BFF:014D 'strt yd' in the save game; diff: To Go = 10 - |spot - series_start|

los.meaning: line of scrimmage of the play being run/shown (yards from the left goal)
los.evidence: diff: equals the pre-play spot at the first graphics frame of 11 plays; check

dir_home.meaning: direction the home team attacks on the text field: +1 right, -1 left

score_home.evidence: code: 0C5F:0058 (team 1); diff against the box score

marker_col.meaning: column of the ball marker on the 80x25 field overview (yards = (col - 14) * 2); moves during kicks shown in text mode
marker_col.evidence: diff: equals the column of the marker glyph

marker_row.meaning: row of the ball marker on the field overview

play_kind.meaning: 'play' of the save game (1 run, 2 pass observed)

roster_home.meaning: home roster: 15-byte records, byte 0 jersey, byte 1 position code (names at DGROUP:090C: OL C TE WR RB QB DL LB DB P K)
roster_home.evidence: code: 0031:0C9E returns DGROUP:516A / 5478 per team (word 0 = team number); diff against the .NFL file

onfield_home.meaning: roster indexes of the home team's 11 players on the field, in the order of the play records
onfield_home.evidence: diff: holds the starters of the formation; check: QB under centre, C on the ball

play_records.meaning: the graphics play: 23 records (x, y, k) in CGA pixels relative to the scrolled field; 0-10 offence (drawn as O), 11-21 defence (X), 22 the ball. The sprite's top-left corner
play_records.evidence: diff: equal to the X/O positions recognised in CGA memory at every frame; check

cam_x.meaning: horizontal field scroll: field_x = record_x - cam_x (fraction byte at 8752)
cam_x.evidence: diff: changes exactly when the field scrolls sideways; check

cam_y.meaning: vertical field scroll: field_y = record_y + cam_y (fraction byte at 8754)
cam_y.evidence: diff: changes exactly when the yard lines scroll; check

field.about: Graphics field geometry (CGA pixels, field coordinates as defined by cam_x/cam_y): 8 px per yard both ways; the CGA-left sideline is at field_x = left_sideline_x; yards from the left goal = los + (los_y - (field_y + sprite_centre)) / 8 where los_y depends on the attacking direction of the team with the ball. Measured from the yard lines and sidelines the game draws (tools/modern/research.py), verified by check_positions.py.
